WITH hire_counts AS (
  SELECT source, COUNT(*) AS total_applicants, SUM(CASE WHEN is_hired = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS hires
  FROM applicants
  GROUP BY source
)
SELECT source,
       ROUND(100.0 * hires / total_applicants, 2) AS hire_rate
FROM hire_counts
ORDER BY hire_rate DESC;
